name: FckSignups
description_en: A list of tools that are open-source, in-browser, and require no-signups!
readme_excerpt: NoSignups (formerly FckSignups) > Open Source Tools. Zero Bullsht. A curated collection of open-source tools you can use instantly in your browser. no accounts, no emails, no tracking. Just tools that work. What is this? NoSignups is a React + TypeScript project. If you want to run it locally, simply clone the repo, install the depedencies, and run the server. Here's a command that would do all the previous steps in one go: Philosophy | We believe | We reject | | Tools should work immediately |…
